data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: Qwen-Agent
ui_devex.summary: Qwen-Agent是一个基于Qwen大模型的开源智能体框架，旨在让AI系统能够自主分解并执行复杂任务，提升实际应用中的问题解决能力。其技术核心在于将函数调用、代码解释、检索增强生成等多种能力模块化集成，通过协同工作实现更可靠的推理流程。开发者可利用该框架构建能联网搜索、分析数据或处理文档的AI助手，也可通过扩展其Chrome插件等组件来创建个性化的自动化工具，适合探索智能体技术的实际落地场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: Qwen-Agent is an open-source framework that enables large language models to perform complex tasks by breaking them down into manageable steps, solving the challenge of making AI systems more autonomous and capable. Its technical strength lies in integrating multiple specialized components like function calling, code interpretation, and retrieval-augmented generation into a cohesive system. Developers can use it to build AI assistants that browse the web, analyze data, or automate workflows by extending its modular architecture with custom tools and applications.

ui_devex.name: react-grab
ui_devex.summary: React Grab 是一个 TypeScript 库，让开发者能够直接从网页界面中选取代码上下文，供 AI 编程助手使用。它通过提供结构化的 DOM 选择工具来捕获 UI 组件及其关系，使编程助手能理解应用的实际结构，而不仅仅是代码文件。开发者可将其集成到 React 应用中，将真实的 UI 状态传递给 AI 工具，从而实现基于实际渲染组件而非仅源代码的更精准代码生成和重构建议，提升开发效率。
ui_devex.summary_en: React Grab is a TypeScript library that enables developers to select and extract code context directly from web interfaces for AI coding assistants. It works by providing structured DOM selection tools that capture UI components and their relationships, allowing coding agents to understand application structure beyond just code files. Developers can integrate it into React applications to feed real UI state to AI tools, enabling more accurate code generation and refactoring suggestions based on actual rendered components rather than just source files.

agents_workflows.name: CyberStrikeAI
agents_workflows.summary: CyberStrikeAI是一个用Go语言构建的AI原生安全测试平台，旨在通过自动化复杂的安全测试流程来降低渗透测试的技术门槛。其核心在于智能编排引擎，能够根据预定义的安全角色和专项测试技能，协调上百种安全工具协同工作，模拟真实攻击链。用户可通过配置不同的测试场景来评估系统安全性，或基于其模块化架构添加自定义工具，将其集成到开发流程中实现持续安全验证。
agents_workflows.summary_en: CyberStrikeAI is an AI-native security testing platform that automates complex penetration testing workflows, making advanced security assessments more accessible. Built in Go, it features an intelligent orchestration engine that coordinates over 100 security tools through predefined security roles and specialized testing skills. Developers can use it to simulate realistic attack scenarios, extend its capabilities by adding custom tools, or integrate it into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security validation.

Built in Go, it features an intelligent orchestration engine that coordinates over 100 security tools through predefined security roles and specialized testing skills. Developers can use it to simulate realistic attack scenarios, extend its capabilities by adding custom tools, or integrate it into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security validation.

agents_workflows.name: webnovel-writer
agents_workflows.summary: Webnovel-writer 是一个基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，专门解决 AI 写作中的“遗忘”和“幻觉”问题，支持超长篇幅的连贯创作。它通过设计精巧的记忆结构，在生成过程中持续追踪角色、情节等关键信息，确保故事在数十万字的规模下保持逻辑一致。其核心启发在于：将长篇叙事视为需要动态维护的上下文状态，而非孤立段落。你可以用它辅助网文连载，保持人物设定不偏离；或借鉴其思路，为其他生成任务构建更稳健的长期记忆模块。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Webnovel-writer is an AI-assisted writing system designed to help authors create long-form web novels by addressing two key challenges: preventing the AI from 'forgetting' plot details and reducing 'hallucinations' where it invents inconsistent content. It achieves this through a structured memory mechanism that maintains context across hundreds of thousands of words, enabling coherent storytelling over extended narratives. You can use it to draft chapters while ensuring character traits and plot points remain consistent, or experiment by integrating it with other language models to enhance creative workflows.

framework_core.name: Qwen-Agent
framework_core.summary: Qwen-Agent是一个基于Qwen大模型的开源智能体框架，旨在让AI系统能够自主分解并执行复杂任务，提升实际应用中的问题解决能力。其技术核心在于将函数调用、代码解释、检索增强生成等多种能力模块化集成，通过协同工作实现更可靠的推理流程。开发者可利用该框架构建能联网搜索、分析数据或处理文档的AI助手，也可通过扩展其Chrome插件等组件来创建个性化的自动化工具，适合探索智能体技术的实际落地场景。
framework_core.summary_en: Qwen-Agent is an open-source framework that enables large language models to perform complex tasks by breaking them down into manageable steps, solving the challenge of making AI systems more autonomous and capable. Its technical strength lies in integrating multiple specialized components like function calling, code interpretation, and retrieval-augmented generation into a cohesive system. Developers can use it to build AI assistants that browse the web, analyze data, or automate workflows by extending its modular architecture with custom tools and applications.

framework_core.name: react-grab
framework_core.summary: React Grab 是一个 TypeScript 库，让开发者能够直接从网页界面中选取代码上下文，供 AI 编程助手使用。它通过提供结构化的 DOM 选择工具来捕获 UI 组件及其关系，使编程助手能理解应用的实际结构，而不仅仅是代码文件。开发者可将其集成到 React 应用中，将真实的 UI 状态传递给 AI 工具，从而实现基于实际渲染组件而非仅源代码的更精准代码生成和重构建议，提升开发效率。
framework_core.summary_en: React Grab is a TypeScript library that enables developers to select and extract code context directly from web interfaces for AI coding assistants. It works by providing structured DOM selection tools that capture UI components and their relationships, allowing coding agents to understand application structure beyond just code files. Developers can integrate it into React applications to feed real UI state to AI tools, enabling more accurate code generation and refactoring suggestions based on actual rendered components rather than just source files.
